text: The next question belongs to Europe. There are bigger nights ahead, with opponents who can press better, recover faster, and make a lost ball feel fatal. Barcelona will have to prove that their control can match their attacking ambition. But the scouting problem is already here. If the center backs hold their line, Raphinha can attack the gap. If they follow him, somebody else can run beyond. If the defense leans toward Yamal, he can deliver the ball where Raphinha has just arrived. And if the opposition escapes the first wave, it must still survive Barcelona's pressure to stop the next one. That is what the Sevilla comeback showed beneath the hat-trick. Flick has turned a devastating winger into a central question with more than one answer. Europe may find a way to contain it. Until then, every attempt to solve Raphinha threatens to create another Barcelona problem. That is why this is a question for any club drawn against them, not just a Barcelona highlight package. The opposition may arrive with a plan for Yamal. It still needs one for the striker who is never quite standing where he was expected.
